name: Frei Paulo (Brazil)
description: Divided by a yellow chevron issuing from the hoist into a green upper part and a dark blue lower part, charged at the centre with a white shield reading FREI PAULO 23-10-1920 with a bull and cotton.
history: Frei Paulo is a municipality in the state of Sergipe, Brazil.
